name: Glovis America Port Vehicle Processing - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.facility: Roster address 2064 E 11th St is a small office building in a residential block, not the operational yard. The Glovis Jacksonville port vehicle-processing operation runs out of the JAXPORT Talleyrand Marine Terminal auto-import complex ~0.4 mi south. Talleyrand handles auto imports for multiple processors; the audited yard is the auto-import vehicle processing area at ~30.346,-81.625.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed truck gate in Street View (2022 + 2025): a sliding chain-link gate across the truck lane with a check-in lane, STOP sign and overhead message board. Gate signage references 'Talleyrand' / 'Southeast Toyota'.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Definitive -- a white/red multi-window guard booth (single-vehicle footprint) sits in the entry lane beside the sliding gate, visible clearly in Street View and as a dark rooftop box in z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 estimate -- the elongated central processing/PDI buildings show a regular rhythm of roll-up service-bay doors. These are vehicle processing/wash/PDI bays, not classic freight docks; banded with low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ -- the yard is dominated by finished-vehicle storage, thousands of cars in marked rows. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: false (uncertain) -- the broader Talleyrand terminal is rail-served (Talleyrand ICTF), but no rail spur is visible running into the vehicle storage yard itself; vehicle import is primarily RoRo ship + car-carrier truck.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Talleyrand hosts several auto-import operators in adjacent yards; the audited footprint is one large yard cluster -- left false, flagged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron at the gate and broad internal roadways leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban -- JAXPORT Talleyrand industrial district within the Jacksonville metro along the St. Johns River.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~70 acres for the audited yard cluster derived from the perimeter box; the full Talleyrand auto complex is larger.

citations.claim: Glovis America lists Glovis America - Jacksonville at 2064 E 11th St, Jacksonville, FL 32206, serving JAXPORT auto operations.

verification.rationale: Glovis lists a Jacksonville port-processing location at 2064 E 11th St; rests on the Tier-1 locator alone (no corroborating dated press/careers), no negative found - holds at probable. Flag: Blount Islands named processors are AMPORTS/Wallenius Wilhelmsen.
